resource_risks.description: The Ctrl/Cmd+, and Escape shortcuts use a global keydown listener that could remain registered after MonitorShell unmounts.
resource_risks.mitigation: The listener is registered in a React effect and removed in the cleanup function.

resource_risks.description: Snapshot loading now races a public snapshot fetch with a timeout and dynamic generated snapshot fallback.
resource_risks.mitigation: The fetch path uses AbortController when available, clears the timeout, and the generated snapshot fallback is a bounded dynamic import.

resource_risks.description: A local static preview server was started for final UI inspection.
resource_risks.mitigation: The failed Next dev server was stopped; the remaining Python static server is intentionally left running so the user can open the delivered preview URL.
resource_risks.rationale: The preview server is the user-facing handoff for this frontend task and can be stopped after review.

lifecycle_checks.resource: snapshot fetch timeout and optional AbortController

lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: Manual stop after user review; no background build watcher remains.
evidence: Preview URL remains available for user review: http://127.0.0.1:3018/
lifecycle_checks.rationale: The server is intentionally retained as the delivered preview surface.

measurement_checks.threshold: No loading indicator, no body horizontal overflow on desktop or mobile.

notes: No persistent polling loop, worker, or unbounded cache was added.
